source_doc.title: Micron FY2025 Form 10-K — Competitive Conditions addendum（Micron 反路徑，[255] 授權研究）
source_doc.permission_basis: Official public SEC filing; canonical URL retained, research-relevant excerpts stored in library/raw.

sources.locator: Part I Item 1 Business — Competitive Conditions
sources.quote: We face intense competition in the semiconductor memory and storage markets from a number of companies, including Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.; SK hynix Inc.; Kioxia Holdings Corporation; Sandisk Corporation; ChangXin Memory Technologies, Inc. (“CXMT”); and Yangtze Memory Technologies Co., Ltd. (“YMTC”).

claims.statement: Micron identifies Samsung Electronics and SK hynix (among others) as competitors in semiconductor memory and storage — issuer-side self-declaration of intense competition, which is an admissible counter-path anchor because it is a statement against interest.
claims.disproof_condition: Update if subsequent 10-K filings materially change the named competitor set for memory and storage.
